findings.passage: “We should not go down the path of amending our constitution every time we may disagree on a particular issue of policy, and certainly there’s disagreement on this particular issue,” said Sen. Steve Santarsiero, D-Bucks.
findings.note: Quoted by the Sun Gazette on the Senate's passage of SB 735, a proposed constitutional amendment requiring ID each time a person votes. He objects to using a constitutional amendment for this issue. Exact day of the remark not shown on the page text I read.

findings.passage: “Pennsylvania has successfully administered free and fair elections at the local, state and federal level since the power was first given to the states by the Founding Fathers.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name on the federal Justice Department lawsuit over the state's refusal to hand over registered-voter data. Relates to voter-roll data and election integrity, not ID itself.
